title: [review] transport.rs: Duplicate CongestionError type definition
description: CongestionError is defined here with the same fields as duty_cycle::CongestionError (lines 131-155 in duty_cycle.rs). In Rust, these are distinct types despite identical structure. Code that mixes imports from both modules will get type mismatch errors. The transport module already imports CongestionLevel and CongestionState from duty_cycle - it should also import or re-export CongestionError rather than redefining it.
